import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    static final int MAX_LEN = 300;

    static class Arc {
        int origin, terminus, reverse, current, limit;

        Arc() {
            origin = 0;
            terminus = 0;
            reverse = 0;
            current = 0;
            limit = 0;
        }

        Arc(int o, int t, int r, int c, int l) {
            origin = o;
            terminus = t;
            reverse = r;
            current = c;
            limit = l;
        }

        int available() {
            return limit - current;
        }
    }

    static class FlowEngine {
        int vertexCount;
        List<Arc>[] adjacency;
        Arc[][] parentArc;
        int[] level;

        FlowEngine(int n) {
            vertexCount = n;
            adjacency = new List[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adjacency[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            parentArc = new Arc[1][n];
            level = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        }

        void addArc(int u, int v, int cap) {
            Arc forward = new Arc(u, v, adjacency[v].size(), 0, cap);
            Arc backward = new Arc(v, u, adjacency[u].size(), 0, 0);
            adjacency[u].add(forward);
            adjacency[v].add(backward);
        }

        void addSymmetric(int u, int v, int cap) {
            Arc forward = new Arc(u, v, adjacency[v].size(), 0, cap);
            Arc backward = new Arc(v, u, adjacency[u].size(), 0, cap);
            adjacency[u].add(forward);
            adjacency[v].add(backward);
        }

        boolean buildLevels(int source, int sink) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(source);
            level[source] = 0;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == sink) return true;
                for (Arc e : adjacency[u]) {
                    if (level[e.terminus] == -1 && e.available() > 0) {
                        level[e.terminus] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.terminus);
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int push(int u, int sink, int flowLimit) {
            if (u == sink) return flowLimit;
            for (int i = 0; i < adjacency[u].size(); ++i) {
                Arc e = adjacency[u].get(i);
                if (level[e.terminus] == level[u] + 1 && e.available() > 0) {
                    int pushed = push(e.terminus, sink, Math.min(flowLimit, e.available()));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.current += pushed;
                        adjacency[e.terminus].get(e.reverse).current -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long totalFlow(int src, int snk) {
            long result = 0;
            while (buildLevels(src, snk)) {
                int pushed;
                while ((pushed = push(src, snk, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                    result += pushed;
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static int[][] terrain = new int[MAX_LEN][MAX_LEN];
    static int[][] shelterCapacity = new int[MAX_LEN][MAX_LEN];
    static int[][][] poisonMap = new int[61][MAX_LEN][MAX_LEN];

    static class Entity {
        int row, col, quantity;

        Entity(int r, int c, int q) {
            row = r;
            col = c;
            quantity = q;
        }

        boolean within(int size) {
            return row >= 0 && row < size && col >= 0 && col < size && terrain[row][col] == -1;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (this == obj) return true;
            if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
            Entity entity = (Entity) obj;
            return row == entity.row && col == entity.col;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(row, col);
        }
    }

    static boolean inBounds(int r, int c, int size) {
        return new Entity(r, c, 0).within(size);
    }

    static List<Entity> people = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Entity> exits = new ArrayList<>();
    static final int[] dRow = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dCol = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int interpret(char c) {
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return -1;
        if (c == 'Y') return -2;
        if (c == 'Z') return -3;
        return -1;
    }

    static int extractDigit(char c) {
        return c - '0';
    }

    static int computeDistance(Entity start, Entity end, int size) {
        boolean[][] visited = new boolean[MAX_LEN][MAX_LEN];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{0, start.row, start.col});
        visited[start.row][start.col] = true;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int time = cur[0];
            int curRow = cur[1];
            int curCol = cur[2];

            if (curRow == end.row && curCol == end.col) return time;
            if (poisonMap[time][curRow][curCol] == 1) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nextRow = curRow + dRow[k];
                int nextCol = curCol + dCol[k];
                Entity next = new Entity(nextRow, nextCol, 0);
                if (next.within(size) && !visited[nextRow][nextCol] && poisonMap[time][nextRow][nextCol] == 0) {
                    q.offer(new int[]{time + 1, nextRow, nextCol});
                    visited[nextRow][nextCol] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static void propagatePoison(int x, int y, int duration, int size) {
        poisonMap[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int t = 1; t <= duration; ++t) {
            for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                    if (poisonMap[t-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        poisonMap[t][i][j] = 1;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                            int ni = i + dRow[k], nj = j + dCol[k];
                            if (ni >= 0 && ni < size && nj >= 0 && nj < size && terrain[ni][nj] == -1)
                                poisonMap[t][ni][nj] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = scanner.nextInt();
        int T = scanner.nextInt();

        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline

        Entity origin = new Entity(0, 0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (interpret(ch) == -1 && Character.isDigit(ch)) {
                    people.add(new Entity(i, j, extractDigit(ch)));
                }
                terrain[i][j] = interpret(ch);
                if (terrain[i][j] == -3) {
                    origin = new Entity(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (interpret(ch) == -1 && Character.isDigit(ch)) {
                    exits.add(new Entity(i, j, extractDigit(ch)));
                    shelterCapacity[i][j] = extractDigit(ch);
                }
            }
        }

        FlowEngine engine = new FlowEngine(MAX_LEN);
        int terminal = MAX_LEN - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < people.size(); ++i) {
            engine.addArc(0, i*2 + 1, people.get(i).quantity);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < exits.size(); ++i) {
            engine.addArc(i*2 + 2, terminal, exits.get(i).quantity);
        }

        propagatePoison(origin.row, origin.col, T, N);

        for (int i = 0; i < people.size(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < exits.size(); ++j) {
                int d = computeDistance(people.get(i), exits.get(j), N);
                if (d <= T) {
                    engine.addArc(i*2 + 1, j*2 + 2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(engine.totalFlow(0, terminal));
    }
}
